## About
My name is Joaquin Ross, and along with my family I run Ross Auto Body Shop in Miami. Auto body repair is what we do, and your satisfaction is our main goal.
Our team will review your vehicle and make sure the work is done in a timely manner and at your convenience. One reviewer told us we sent photos while the car was being worked on and followed up weeks later to make sure everything was right. That is how we like to treat people.
We are rated 5 on Google from 148 reviews. Call us and we will take a look.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Dents, scratches and collision damage, big jobs or small ones.
- Repair and paint: One reviewer brought in a truck after an accident and praised the repair and paint work.
- Insurance claim help: We help you deal with the insurance company and guide you through the process.
- Towing Services: Free towing when your vehicle is repaired at our facility.
- Estimates: We review your vehicle and give you an estimate.
- 3-year Warranty: A 3-year warranty when your vehicle is repaired at our facility.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer towing?
A: Yes, we offer free towing services when your vehicle is repaired at our facility.

Q: Can you help me with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We help you through the claim and guide you the whole way.

Q: Do you speak Spanish?
A: Yes, we speak English and Spanish.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at 786-803-8245 to schedule an appointment.
